blocks.text: O'zbekchada ko'p gaplarda ega umuman yo'q: «**Sovuq.**», «Soat **besh**.», «Bugun **dushanba**.», «Uyimizdan maktabgacha **uzoq**.» Ingliz tilida esa har bir gapda ega bo'lishi **shart**. Bunday gaplarda ega o'rnini **it** egallaydi: **It's** cold. **It's** five o'clock. **It's** Monday. **It's** a long way. Bu **it** hech narsani bildirmaydi va tarjima qilinmaydi — «u» emas. U faqat grammatik bo'sh joyni to'ldiradi, chunki inglizcha gap fe'l bilan boshlana olmaydi («Is cold» deyilmaydi).

Soatni so'rash: **What time is it?** yoki **What's the time?** — «Soat necha?», javob: **It's** ten past four. Kunni so'rash: **What day is it** today? — **It's** Tuesday. Sanani so'rash: **What's the date** today? — **It's** the twenty-first of June. Shuningdek: **It's** late. — «Kech bo'ldi». **It's** my birthday. — «Bugun tug'ilgan kunim». **It's** time to go. — «Ketish vaqti bo'ldi». Soat va sana haqida batafsil — 103-dars (at / on / in).

Ob-havo haqidagi deyarli barcha gaplar **it** bilan boshlanadi: **It's** sunny / cloudy / windy / foggy / hot / cold. Yomg'ir va qor uchun inglizlar alohida fe'l ishlatadi: **rain** («yomg'ir yog'moq»), **snow** («qor yog'moq»). Shuning uchun «Yomg'ir yog'yapti» — **It's raining** (Present Continuous), «Bu yerda qishda qor ko'p yog'adi» — **It snows** a lot here in winter (Present Simple), «Kecha yomg'ir yog'di» — **It rained** yesterday. «Rain is falling» deyish mumkin, lekin juda kam eshitiladi. O'zgarish: **It's getting** dark / cold — «Qorong'i / sovuq tushyapti».

items.text: **It's raining** again, so we're staying at home.
items.translation: Yana **yomg'ir yog'yapti**, shuning uchun uyda qolyapmiz.

items.text: **It snowed** a lot in the mountains last week.

blocks.text: Masofani so'rash: **How far is it** from Tashkent to Bukhara? — «Toshkentdan Buxorogacha qancha masofa?». Javob: **It's** about 550 kilometres. **It's** a long way. — «Ancha uzoq». **It isn't** far. — «Uzoq emas». Bu yerda ham o'zbekchada ega yo'q, inglizchada esa **it** kerak. Yo'l qancha vaqt olishi (**How long does it take** ...?) — 48-darsda.

items.text: **It's** a long way from here to the coast.
**How far is it** to the next village? — **It's** about five miles.

blocks.text: O'zbekchada «Ingliz tilini o'rganish **qiziq**», «Sizni ko'rganimdan **xursandman**» deymiz. Inglizchada bunday gapni ko'pincha **It's** + sifat + **to** + fe'l bilan quramiz: **It's** interesting **to** learn English. **It's** nice **to** see you. «To learn English is interesting» ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin juda kitobiy eshitiladi — **It's** ... **to** ... tabiiyroq. Ko'p ishlatiladigan sifatlar: easy, difficult, hard, important, nice, dangerous, possible, expensive. Infinitiv haqida batafsil — 52-dars.

items.text: **It's** difficult **to** find a parking space in the centre.

blocks.text: **there is** — biror joyda nimadir **borligini** aytadi (→ 37-dars), **it** esa ob-havo, vaqt, masofa yoki oldin aytilgan narsa haqida gapiradi. Ba'zan bir fikrni ikkala yo'l bilan aytish mumkin, lekin tuzilishi boshqa: **It's** windy. = **There's** a strong wind. **It rained** a lot. = **There was** a lot of rain. «There is cold» yoki «It is a bank here» esa xato.

rows: **It's** a long way to the beach.
**There's** a nice café on the corner.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Is cold today.» → **It's cold today.**; «Is raining.» / «It's rain.» → **It's raining.**; «There is very hot.» → **It's very hot.**; «Is it far from here?» to'g'ri, «Is far from here?» xato; «Is difficult to learn Chinese.» → **It's difficult to learn Chinese.**; «It is a bank near the station.» → **There's a bank near the station.**
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha gapda ega yo'q bo'lsa («Sovuq», «Soat besh», «Uzoq», «...ish qiyin»), inglizchada ega o'rniga **it** qo'ying. Gapda «bor / yo'q» bo'lsa — **there**.

items: Vaqt va sana: **It's** six o'clock. **It's** Sunday. **It's** the 1st of June.
Ob-havo: **It's** sunny / cold. **It's raining**. **It snows** a lot in winter.
Masofa: **How far is it** to ...? — **It's** ten kilometres. / **It's** a long way.
**it** — ob-havo, vaqt, masofa, aytilgan narsa; **there is** — biror joyda nimadir bor.

examples.title: Time and dates: **It's** half past six
examples.description: Soat, kun va sana haqida gapda ega — **it**: **It's** ten o'clock. **It's** Monday. **It's** the first of May. O'zbekchada esa ega yo'q.

sentences.text: What time is it? — **It's** half past six.
**It's** Monday today, and the shops are open again.
Hurry up! **It's** nearly nine o'clock.
Today **it's** the first of September — the first day of school.
Wake up, Bekzod! **It's** already ten.
Look at the clock: **it's** very late. Let's go home.
sentences.translation: Soatga qara: **juda kech bo'ldi**. Uyga ketaylik.

sentences.text: What's the date today? — **It's** the twelfth of March.
In London **it's** five o'clock now, but in Tashkent **it's** ten.
Tomorrow **it's** Madina's birthday, so we're buying a cake.
sentences.translation: Ertaga Madinaning **tug'ilgan kuni**, shuning uchun tort olyapmiz.

sentences.text: **It was** Sunday, and the streets were very quiet.

examples.title: Weather: **It's** sunny, **it's** raining
examples.description: Ob-havo: **It's** + sifat (hot, windy, cloudy) yoki **it** + fe'l: **It's raining** — «Yomg'ir yog'yapti», **It snows** — «Qor yog'adi».

sentences.text: **It's** very hot today — thirty-eight degrees!
Look out of the window — **it's snowing**!
In Manchester **it rains** a lot, even in summer.
Outside **it's** windy, so wear a warm jacket.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida **shamol esyapti**, shuning uchun issiq kurtka kiy.

sentences.text: **Is it** still raining? — No, **it's** stopped.
In spring **it's** warm and sunny in Tashkent.
Oh, **it's getting** dark already, and it's only five o'clock.
sentences.translation: Voy, allaqachon **qorong'i tushyapti**, soat esa hali besh.

sentences.text: In the mountains **it often snows** in October.
What's the weather like in London? — **It's** cloudy and a bit cold.
Tonight **it's going to** be foggy, so drive carefully.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi **tuman tushadi**, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'lib haydang.

examples.title: Weather in the past and future: **It was**, **It'll be**
examples.description: Ob-havo boshqa zamonlarda ham **it** bilan: **It was** cold, **It rained**, **It'll be** sunny, **It hasn't rained**.

sentences.text: **It was** very cold yesterday.
Last night **it rained** heavily, and the roads are still wet.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi qattiq **yomg'ir yog'di**, yo'llar hali ham ho'l.

sentences.text: Tomorrow **it'll be** sunny in the morning.
When we were in Bukhara, **it was** forty degrees every day.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda bo'lganimizda har kuni **qirq daraja issiq edi**.

sentences.text: **It's been** a very dry summer.
I think **it's going to** rain — look at those black clouds.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, **yomg'ir yog'adi** — anavi qora bulutlarga qara.

sentences.text: On our wedding day **it snowed**, and the photos were beautiful.
sentences.translation: To'yimiz kuni **qor yog'di**, suratlar juda chiroyli chiqdi.

sentences.text: **Was it** windy at the beach? — Yes, very.
Next week **it won't be** so hot, the forecast says.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, kelasi hafta havo bunchalik **issiq bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: **It hasn't rained** here since May.

examples.title: Distance: **How far is it** ...? **It's** ...
examples.description: Masofa: **How far is it** from ... to ...? — «...dan ...gacha qancha masofa?». Javob: **It's** ... kilometres / **It's** a long way / **It isn't** far.

sentences.text: **How far is it** from Tashkent to the Chimgan mountains? — About eighty kilometres.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Chimyon tog'larigacha **qancha masofa**? — Taxminan sakson kilometr.

sentences.text: To the station? **It's** not far — just five minutes on foot.
Is it far to the airport? — No, **it's** quite close.
From my house **it's** a long way to the university.
Excuse me, **how far is it** to the nearest bank?
We can walk — **it's** only two kilometres.
London to Oxford? **It's** about ninety kilometres, I think.
**How far was it** from your hotel to the beach?
Wow, **it's** further than I thought!
My grandparents' village is in the mountains, so **it takes** four hours to get there.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvimning qishlog'i tog'da, u yerga borish uchun to'rt soat **ketadi**.

examples.title: **It's** easy / nice / important **to** ...
examples.description: **It's** + sifat + **to** + fe'l = «...ish oson / qiyin / muhim». O'zbekchadagi «...ish» ega inglizchada gap oxiriga o'tadi, boshida esa **it** turadi.

sentences.text: **It's** easy **to** get lost in the old city of Bukhara.
Mrs Brown, **it's** nice **to** meet you.
**Is it** safe **to** swim here?
For me **it's** difficult **to** get up early in winter.
**It's** important **to** drink enough water in hot weather.
Sometimes **it's** hard **to** understand people from Glasgow!
**Was it** expensive **to** fly to London?
Thank you — **it was** very kind of you **to** help us.
sentences.translation: Rahmat — bizga yordam berib, juda **mehribonlik qildingiz**.

sentences.text: Learning English is fun, but **it isn't** easy **to** remember all the irregular verbs.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini o'rganish qiziq, lekin barcha noto'g'ri fe'llarni **eslab qolish oson emas**.

sentences.text: In Tashkent **it's** possible **to** get almost anywhere by metro or bus.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda deyarli istalgan joyga metro yoki avtobusda **borish mumkin**.

examples.title: Questions: **Is it** ...? **Was it** ...?
examples.description: Savolda **is / was / will** dan keyin **it**: **Is it** cold? **Was it** far? Qisqa javob: Yes, **it is**. / No, **it isn't**.

sentences.text: **Is it** cold outside? — Yes, **it is**. Take a hat.
**Was it** a long journey? — Yes, **it was** — twelve hours by train.
sentences.translation: Yo'l **uzoq bo'ldimi**? — Ha, **uzoq bo'ldi** — poyezdda o'n ikki soat.

sentences.text: What day **is it** today? — **It's** Thursday.
**Is it** far from here to the museum? — No, **it isn't**. You can walk.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan muzeygacha **uzoqmi**? — Yo'q, **uzoq emas**. Piyoda borsangiz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Mum, **is it** time to go? — Not yet, wait five minutes.
sentences.translation: Oyi, ketish **vaqti bo'ldimi**? — Hali yo'q, besh daqiqa kut.

sentences.text: How was the weather in Oxford? — **It was** lovely — warm and sunny.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda havo qanday edi? — **Ajoyib edi** — iliq va quyoshli.

sentences.text: **Will it** be hot in Samarkand in May? — Yes, quite hot.
sentences.translation: Mayda Samarqandda **issiq bo'ladimi**? — Ha, ancha issiq.

sentences.text: Excuse me, what time **is it**? — Sorry, I haven't got a watch.
Dilnoza, **is it** true that you're moving to London?
**Isn't it** a beautiful day? — Yes, perfect for a picnic!
sentences.translation: **Qanday ajoyib kun**, a? — Ha, piknik uchun ayni muddao!

examples.title: **it** ↔ **there**
examples.description: **it** — ob-havo, vaqt, masofa va aytilgan narsa («u»); **there is / was** — biror joyda nimadir bor (→ 37–38-darslar). Ikkalasi bir gapda.

sentences.text: **There's** a strong wind today, and **it's** really cold.
**There was** a lot of snow last night, and this morning **it's** sunny.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi ko'p **qor yog'di**, bugun ertalab esa havo **quyoshli**.

sentences.text: Is **there** a bank near here? — Yes, but **it's** closed on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Yaqin atrofda **bank bormi**? — Ha, lekin u yakshanba kunlari **yopiq**.

sentences.text: **It's** a long way to the city centre, but **there's** a bus every ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazigacha **uzoq**, lekin har o'n daqiqada avtobus **bor**.

sentences.text: Today **it's** very hot, and **there isn't** any wind.
sentences.translation: Bugun havo juda **issiq**, shamol esa umuman **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Look, **there's** a new shop over there. Is **it** a bakery?
sentences.translation: Qara, u yerda yangi do'kon **bor**. U **novvoyxonami**?

sentences.text: Yesterday **it rained** all day, and **there were** puddles everywhere.
sentences.translation: Kecha kun bo'yi **yomg'ir yog'di**, hamma yoqda ko'lmaklar **bor edi**.

sentences.text: In Tashkent **there's** a lot of sun — **it's** sunny almost three hundred days a year.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda quyosh **ko'p** — yiliga deyarli uch yuz kun havo **quyoshli bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **there's** a problem with the heating, so **it's** cold in here.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, isitishda muammo **bor**, shuning uchun bu yer **sovuq**.

sentences.text: Is **it** far? — Not really. **There's** a short way through the park.
sentences.translation: **Uzoqmi**? — Unchalik emas. Bog' orqali qisqa yo'l **bor**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a video call between London and Tashkent
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Tom (London) va Aziz (Toshkent) vaqt, ob-havo va masofa haqida gaplashadi — **it** bilan turli gaplar.

sentences.text: — Hi, Aziz! What time **is it** in Tashkent now?
— Nine in the evening. And in London? **It's** about four, isn't it?
— That's right, **it's** four here. What's the weather like there?
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, bu yerda soat **to'rt**. U yerda havo qanday?

sentences.text: — **It was** really hot today — thirty-five degrees!
sentences.translation: — Bugun juda **issiq bo'ldi** — o'ttiz besh daraja!

sentences.text: — Lucky you! Here **it's** grey, and **it's been raining** since the morning.
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! Bu yerda havo **bulutli**, ertalabdan beri **yomg'ir yog'yapti**.

sentences.text: — Oh no. And **is it** cold too?
— Not very — about twelve degrees. **It's** autumn here, you know.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas — o'n ikki daraja atrofida. Bilasan-ku, bu yerda **kuz**.

sentences.text: — How far **is it** from your flat to the office?
— Only three kilometres, but in this rain **it takes** forty minutes by bus!
sentences.translation: — Bor-yo'g'i uch kilometr, lekin bunday yomg'irda avtobusda qirq daqiqa **ketadi**!

sentences.text: — Come to Tashkent, then! **It'll** be warm here until the end of October.
sentences.translation: — Unda Toshkentga kel! Bu yerda oktyabr oxirigacha havo **iliq bo'ladi**.
